declarations.docstring: An auxiliary type assembled from a family of types indexed by natural numbers.
Auxiliary multiplicative data used to parametrize permutations centralizing the cycle shift.
An auxiliary type associated with a label type and a natural-number cycle size.
A permutation centralizing the cycle shift commutes pointwise with every natural power of that shift.
The permutation induced on labels of a fixed cycle size by a permutation centralizing the cycle shift.
The induced permutation on cycle labels is the first component of the associated cycle parameter.
The target label and cyclic offset associated with a centralizing permutation and a cycle label.
The first components of the cycle parameters for a centralizing permutation and its inverse compose to the identity in one order.
The first components of the cycle parameters for a centralizing permutation and its inverse compose to the identity in the other order.
A centralizing permutation sends a cycle point to the parameterized target label and adds the associated cyclic offset.
Permutation of a function domain as a monoid homomorphism into multiplicative automorphisms of group-valued functions.
The permuted function evaluates at a point by applying the original function to its inverse image.
On each cycle label, a centralizing permutation acts by a target label and a fixed cyclic offset.
A permutation centralizing the cycle shift preserves the natural-number index of every cycle point.
The natural-number index of the image under a centralizing permutation divides the original cycle size.
For a finite label type, the auxiliary factor has cardinality equal to the cycle size raised to the label cardinality times its factorial.
If the zeroth label type is empty, any index carrying a label is nonzero.
A dependent function space whose factors above a bound are subsingletons is equivalent to the corresponding finite dependent function space.
The action of centralizer parameter data on the indexed cycle space.
Centralizer data acts by permuting a cycle label and adding the associated cyclic component to its position.
The action of a product of centralizer data is the composite of the two actions.
The identity centralizer datum acts as the identity.
The action of centralizer data commutes with the canonical cycle shift.
A multiplicative equivalence between centralizer data and the subgroup of permutations centralizing the cycle shift.
The permutation underlying the centralizer-data equivalence agrees with the permutation homomorphism.
The monoid homomorphism from centralizer data to permutations of the indexed cycle space.
The permutation homomorphism acts on cycle points by the centralizer-data action.
The permutation homomorphism from centralizer data is injective.
Every permutation arising from centralizer data belongs to the centralizer of the cycle shift.
Extracting data from a centralizing permutation and mapping it back recovers the original permutation.
The canonical permutation of the indexed cycle space that advances each cyclic coordinate.
The cycle shift fixes the index and label and adds one to the cyclic coordinate.
A natural power of the cycle shift adds the cast of that power to the cyclic coordinate.
Equality of two dependent pairs with the same natural-number index implies equality of their second components.
Centralizer parameter data extracted from a permutation belonging to the cycle-shift centralizer.
An equivalence of label types induces a multiplicative equivalence of their auxiliary centralizer factors.
The auxiliary centralizer factor of an empty label type is a subsingleton.
